newsitem.title: POLAND: Five feared dead in Polish yachting accident.
newsitem.headline: Five feared dead in Polish yachting accident.

text.p: Five people are missing and presumed drowned after a yacht capsized on a windswept lake near the Polish Baltic port of Szczecin, police said on Monday.

The five -- three Polish and two German citizens, ranging in age from 19 to 28 -- were swept into the icy waters of Lake Dabie about 900 metres (half a mile) from shore when their 5.5-metre (17-foot) yacht capsized on Sunday, PAP news agency reported.
A 23-year-old Pole identified only as Dariusz C. managed to swim to shore, but lost his wife and brother in the accident, PAP said. Norbert S., a 23-year-old German, also swam to safety.
A police duty officer in Szczecin told Reuters by telephone that the search had been suspended.
A rescue official said on public television that no one could survive in the near-freezing water for more than about 30 minutes.
